levels.name: Win
levels.q: Did they win, and did they deserve to?

levels.name: Goals
levels.q: Did they outscore opponents, and was it finishing, goaltending or luck?

levels.name: Chance quality
levels.q: Did they create better chances than they allowed?

levels.name: Shot volume
levels.q: Did they out-shoot opponents, and how were shots generated?

levels.name: Territory & possession
levels.q: Where was the puck, and who won it back?

levels.name: Transition
levels.q: How did they get the puck into and out of each zone?

levels.name: Process & skill
levels.q: Which plays (passes, forechecks, shot types) fed everything above?

levels.name: Special teams
levels.q: How did the power play and penalty kill add or cost goals?
